messages.subject: QA about  tree_subset() and ViewClade()
parts:
Dear professor,
I have some QA for ViewClade() and tree_subset().
I read the MCC tree, and want to use the tree_subset(MCC_tree, node = number) to get the substitution rate data of one branch of the tree. But using the tree_subset(), the root of the branch was not including. How can I include it?
I also try to use the ViewClade(MCC_tree, MRCA(tree, c("A", "B"), the root of this branch was including. But how can I get the substitution rate of the branch by using ViewClade().

Best wishes to you.
Thank you.
